name: PoEtRy
author: Laazirfa
description: Skip the green orb at 21% to fall between the saw and cube portal at 22% (you can hit the slope behind the green orb to make this more consistent). Spam to go under the platform at 23%. Stay in the level until the end of the large spike block at 27% where you can fall above the level. Stay at a constant position above the level except for 97% where you need to land on the platform made of black blocks to complete the level.
